audit.notes: This format is entirely composed of day-in-the-life b-roll clips (working on a laptop, drinking coffee, making a snack, walking outside, quick convenience store run) synced to upbeat music with time-stamp text overlays. Anyone with lifestyle b-roll can recreate this exact structure for their own remote work or study day.
audit.summary: A chronological 'day in the life' vlog showing the creator's first day working remotely in tech sales, featuring laptop work, coffee breaks, making lunch, a quick errand to 7/11, and afternoon training sessions, set to music with on-screen timestamps.
